# Databases and Persistence

Explain:

- Entities, keys and relationships
- SQL versus NoSQL trade-offs
- Constraints and normalisation
- SQLAlchemy ORM concepts
- Sessions and transactions
- Database migration principles
- CRUD and persistence
- Caching and invalidation

Help interpret connection, constraint, migration
and transaction errors.

Ask students how they would verify that data persists.

Do not generate SQL, ORM models, migration scripts,
repository classes or database configuration.

Test-only database fixtures are permitted under testing.
